implementationDirection: Keep the eight observed low/high plunge templates separate from the other 16 partial action IDs; the shared formula/observation workflow already covers their defined math.

For Nefer, Linnea, and Sandrone, the broad local-code gap is observed event/state binding for source-documented resource, summon, or charged cycles; implement editors only around concrete event fields, and require observed values/timing.
For Kachina and Alyosha, event-entry infrastructure already exists; request the missing observation state and bind it to the selected action rather than duplicate the ledger.
For Lohen, the Will formula/ledger already exists; require complete observed input.

No missing formula in this inventory justifies adding default hit counts, frames, resource values, or automatic schedules. The partial denominator should stay intact until mapping requirements and evidence actually close.
verificationBoundary: Source/archive formula availability and local calculator code are not current-game execution evidence. No active verified snapshot exists; preview data remains a separate partial observed snapshot and does not supply action events for these mappings.
